answer: Tie each identity to a rented slice of compute. Registration needs a signed GPU-rental receipt from a cloud provider: one paid, non-transferable rental per identity, bound to the agent key and re-verified every epoch. The receipt is the nectar that keeps an identity alive; without usage proofs, rewards stop. A Sybil operator must rent a separate GPU per fake identity, so cost grows linearly while payout stays flat. Two keys sharing one receipt are both slashed. The network pulse is measured in rentals, not claims: a kernel of honest compute under each identity makes mass forgery uneconomic.
